title: Concurrent holds disrupt high-demand SKU reservations
summary: Reservation requests for a popular SKU intermittently return conflict responses even though the operator view still shows available units.
precursor: A flash-sale window opened and the same SKU began receiving parallel holds from several checkout replicas.
impact: Some checkout sessions cannot secure stock on the first attempt, raising retry traffic and lowering conversion during the sale.

title: New catalog items fail warehouse reservation
summary: Reservation attempts for a subset of newly listed items fail while established catalog items continue to reserve normally.
precursor: A supplier catalog import completed shortly before the warehouse availability feed began including the new item codes.
impact: Customers cannot complete checkout for affected items despite warehouse staff reporting on-hand stock.

title: Reservation traffic sees intermittent connection failures
summary: The reservation gateway records short bursts of upstream connection errors, with successful requests returning between bursts.
precursor: A node drain rescheduled inventory read replicas across the zone during a routine maintenance window.
impact: Availability checks and stock holds intermittently fail for shoppers routed through the affected gateway replicas.

title: One depot stops applying replenishment updates
summary: On-hand quantities stop advancing for one depot while feed processing and stock changes at other depots remain current.
precursor: The overnight warehouse import started after a partner feed rollout that expanded the set of location attributes.
impact: The affected depot advertises outdated availability, causing reservations to be rejected later or usable stock to remain hidden.

title: Supplier allocation delays availability responses
summary: Availability lookups for supplier-managed items exceed the response deadline and intermittently show no result, while local-stock lookups remain responsive.
precursor: A supplier allocation batch began covering a broader daily assortment during the afternoon ordering peak.
impact: Product pages and checkout cannot confirm availability for affected items, deferring orders until retries succeed.
